- **Dec–Feb repair, then second flush:** Rebound to 259.68 (1/23/26), then a violent 107.2M-share capitulation on **2026-02-04** (close 200.19, low 199.15) with a follow-on low of 190.72 (2/5).
- **March basing:** Closes held the ~191–205 zone for six weeks (e.g., 190.95 on 3/3, low 189.02 on 3/9).

## 4. Detailed Trend Analysis by Indicator

**close_200_sma (415.98):** The critical structural event of the week occurred on **2026-11-05, when the close of 404.40 broke *below* the then-200-SMA of 415.00** — the first close under the long-term trend line in the entire rally. The 11/06 session reclaimed it decisively (close 449.04, +7.9% above; even the intraday low of 433.30 stayed above the band). This is the single most important line in the setup: a decisive loss of ~416 re-opens the whole structure below.

**close_50_sma (546.81):** After climbing relentlessly all year, the 50 SMA has **flattened and turned down for the first time in the 30-day window** (548.90 on 11/04 → 547.37 → 546.81). Price sits **17.9% below it**. Until AMD can retake ~547, the intermediate trend is objectively down.

**close_10_ema (487.93):** Plunging ~22% in a month. Price is ~8.0% below it, and notably the **11/06 rally high (459.78) never even reached the 10 EMA** — the bounce has so far been entirely sub-reversion. This makes ~488 the first meaningful resistance test.

**macd / macds:** The bearish crossover fired between **10/08 (MACD 34.17 vs signal 33.76) and 10/09 (30.92 vs 33.19)**. The line went negative on 10/20 and has since deepened to −30.20 vs signal −17.45 (histogram −12.76). Sequence of the histogram over the last three sessions: −9.06 (11/04) → −13.60 (11/05) → −12.76 (11/06) — a marginal one-day narrowing, but no bullish crossover or confirmed momentum inflection yet. Momentum remains firmly in a bearish regime.

**rsi (38.41):** Textbook downtrend rhythm — overbought extreme 70.70 on 10/07, then a ladder of lower highs (61.3 → 57.2 → 55.8 → 53.6 → 50.9 → ~45 → ~40) into the 11/05 oversold print of **29.75** (the only sub-30 reading in the 30-day window). The bounce to 38.41 is consistent with a dead-cat snap; RSI in the 35–45 zone inside a downtrend is *not* a value zone, and the lower-high pattern must be broken (~50) before momentum can be called repaired.

**boll_lb (425.70):** The 11/05 capitulation was a **full outside-band excursion** — both the low (402.10) and close (404.40) printed *below* the lower band (434.55 that day), the classic washout signature. The 11/06 close is back inside (band now 425.70, still falling fast at ~9 pts/day). Note the compression risk: with the band falling toward price, an early re-test is likely.

**atr (36.61):** Volatility has nearly **doubled in 30 days** (23.43 on 10/07 → 36.61 now). Daily true ranges of 55–70 points are now routine (11/05 range: 54.10 points; 11/06 range: 26.48). **Risk sizing implication: a 1× ATR stop = ~37 pts (~8%); a 2× ATR stop = ~73 pts (~16%).** Position sizes must be cut roughly in half versus the summer regime.

**Volume context:** The flush sequence escalated methodically — 32.1M (11/02) → 35.3M → 51.0M → **71.2M (11/05)** → 45.6M (11/06) — against an October baseline of 13–28M. The historical rhyme is notable: the **2/4/26 flush (107.2M, close 200.19) marked the cycle's major low area (~190–200)** that launched the entire rally. That is an observation, not a prediction, but capitulation-volume washouts have been the structure's turning points this year.

---

| Support 1 | **425.70** | Bollinger lower band (falling ~9 pts/day) |

---

## 6. Scenario Framework

**Bull path (repair):** A close above ~488 (10 EMA) *with* the MACD histogram continuing to narrow would signal genuine momentum repair. Targets: 504–513, then the 527–547 confluence. Sustained trade above 547 invalidates the intermediate downtrend.

**Base case (chop):** Price oscillates between the falling lower band (~426 and descending) and the 10 EMA (~488 and descending) while ATR stays >30. This compresses into a volatility resolution — direction to be determined by the 402/416 floor vs. 488/513 ceiling.

**Bear path (retest):** A decisive close below 415.98 (200 SMA) followed by a failure of 402.10 would confirm trend failure, opening air pockets toward the 350s and, ultimately, the February–March historical base at **190–200** (verified closes: 200.19 on 2/4, 190.95 on 3/3; verified lows: 190.72 on 2/5, 189.02 on 3/9).

---

## 7. Actionable Takeaways

1. **Do not chase the 11/06 bounce.** It is sub-10-EMA, on RSI 38 in a downtrend, with the MACD still pressing to new lows. Treat it as a relief rally until 488 is reclaimed.
2. **The 402–416 zone is the line in the sand.** Longs can use it as a risk anchor; a decisive break (close below 402 with follow-through) warrants full de-risking.
3. **Size down.** With ATR at 36.61 (~8.2% of price), normal position sizes carry abnormal dollar risk. A 2× ATR stop is ~73 points — most traders should hold smaller exposure with wider stops, not tighter stops with full size.
4. **First objective trade:** a *pullback* toward 426–433 (lower band / today's low) that holds above 416 offers better reward-to-risk than buying 449 into resistance. First confirmation trade: a reclaim and hold of 488–504.
5. **Watch volume on any retest.** The 71.2M washout on 11/05 mirrors the 107.2M flush of 2/4/26 that marked the prior major low. A quiet-volume retest of 402–416 that holds would be the highest-conviction long entry; heavy-volume failure there confirms distribution.
6. **Mean-reversion shorts** toward the 527–547 confluence have favorable structure (falling 10 EMA + flat 50 SMA) but should respect the oversold band excursion already printed — shorting strength (488–513) beats shorting weakness.

---

## 8. Key Points Summary Table

| 6 | RSI | 38.41 after oversold 29.75 (11/05); lower highs from 70.70 (10/07) | Bounce, not reversal |

| 8 | ATR | 36.61 (30-day high, ~2× the 10/07 level); ~8.2% of price | Cut position sizes, widen stops |

| 10 | Key levels | Support 426 / 416 / 402; Resistance 488 / 504–513 / 527–547 | Trade the range, respect 402 |
| 11 | Base case | Chop between ~426 and ~488 while momentum repairs | Patience; buy pullbacks above 416 |

**Bottom line:** AMD is in the aftermath of a parabolic-top break with a genuine volume capitulation just printed and one strong reclaim day. The structure says *bearish until proven otherwise* — below the falling 10 EMA (487.93) and 17.9% under a rolling-over 50 SMA — but the 200 SMA reclaim, oversold band excursion, and capitulation volume argue the downside is entering a decision zone (402–416). The highest-quality setups are either buying a low-volume retest that holds 416, or confirmation longs above 488–504 — with ATR-driven sizing mandatory in this volatility regime.
